subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If the proposal head differs from the revision bound to any live pass or aggregate, then the system shall mark the complete process `review-stale`, preserve it, and require every FR-24 pass on the new exact head before acceptance
intent: stale process and forced full-set re-review
fit_criterion: one post-review edit stales one-pass and two-pass processes alike; no old pass is reused; acceptance resumes only after the new full set satisfies
